limits: This checks internal published accounting arithmetic, not the underlying bank transactions or every business purpose.
Zero arithmetic residual is not an audit of fraud controls or proof that every expenditure was appropriate.
Working-capital adjustments are not a vendor-payment list and cannot identify who received money.
College and Foundation are consolidated with inter-company eliminations. Comparative values may be reclassified.
Cash balances are stocks; adjustment rows, components and subtotals overlap and must not be indiscriminately added.
The provincial departmental forecast is not reconciled by this institution-only bridge.
Only numeric facts, source identifiers and concise independent explanations are projected; no signatures, audit opinion text, personal records or source-page images.
